025//@formatter:off
026/**
027 * The main entry point and configuration of RainbowGum logging.
028 * <p>
029 * RainbowGum logging loads configuration through the service loader. While you can
030 * manually set RainbowGum using {@link #set(Supplier)} it is better to register
031 * implementations through the ServiceLoader so that RainbowGum will load prior to any
032 * external logging.
033 * <p>
034 * To register a custom RainbowGum:
035 *
036 *
037{@snippet class="snippets.RainbowGumProviderExample" region="provider" :
038
039class RainbowGumProviderExample implements RainbowGumProvider {
040
041        @Override
042        public Optional<RainbowGum> provide(LogConfig config) {
043
044                Integer bufferSize = config.properties() //
045                        .forKey("logging.custom.async.bufferSize")
046                        .ofInt()
047                        .or(1024)
048                        .validateNow(RainbowGumProviderExample.class);
049
050                LogProvider<LogOutput> output = (name, cfg) -> cfg.properties()
051                        .forKey("logging.custom.output")
052                        .ofProvider(LogOutput::of)
053                        .or(LogOutput.ofStandardOut())
054                        .validateNow(RainbowGumProviderExample.class)
055                        .provide(name, cfg);
056
057                var gum = RainbowGum.builder() //
058                        .route(r -> {
059                                r.publisher(PublisherFactory //
060                                        .async() //
061                                        .bufferSize(bufferSize) //
062                                        .build());
063                                r.appender("console", a -> {
064                                        a.output(output);
065                                });
066                                r.level(Level.INFO);
067                        })
068                        .build();
069
070                return Optional.of(gum);
071        }
072
073}
074}
075 * <p>
076 * <strong>Initialization order</strong> - most of the actual work happens in
077 * {@link LogConfig.Builder#build()}, {@link LogRouter.Router.Builder}, and
078 * {@code LogAppenderRegistry}; this is the exact sequence for anyone debugging a
079 * configuration or writing a {@link RainbowGumServiceProvider.RainbowGumProvider}:
080 * <ol>
081 * <li>{@link LogConfig.Builder#build()} builds the shared {@link LogConfig}:
082 * <ol>
083 * <li>Resolve the {@link ServiceRegistry} (default: a new empty one) and
084 * {@link LogProperties} - manually added
085 * {@link RainbowGumServiceProvider.PropertiesProvider}s, else (if a
086 * {@link java.util.ServiceLoader} was supplied) SPI-discovered ones, with system
087 * properties always layered in as a final fallback. Providers receive a temporary
088 * {@link LogAlerts} collector.</li>
089 * <li>Build {@link LogAlerts} and {@link LogMetrics} from properties.</li>
090 * <li>Build the global level resolver ({@code logging.level.*} and
091 * {@code logging.group.*}, plus anything added directly on the builder).</li>
092 * <li>Construct the {@link LogConfig} itself and replay provider alerts into its
093 * configured {@link LogAlerts}. This is also where a few
094 * process-wide flags get latched (config change support, the appender lock, and
095 * thread-local-disabled globals) and the default output/encoder/publisher
096 * registries are created.</li>
097 * <li>Run every {@link RainbowGumServiceProvider.Configurator} (manually added,
098 * then SPI-discovered), highest {@linkplain RainbowGumServiceProvider.Configurator#priority()
099 * priority} first. A configurator returning {@code false} is retried in a later
100 * pass (see {@link RainbowGumServiceProvider#PASSES}) - useful if it depends on
101 * another configurator running first.</li>
102 * <li>Start {@link LogAlerts} - deliberately last, so a configurator's own alert
103 * listener is already registered before alerts decides whether an unobserved
104 * error should refuse startup.</li>
105 * </ol>
106 * </li>
107 * <li>{@link Builder#build()} builds each named {@link LogRouter.Router} (a single
108 * route named {@value LogProperties#DEFAULT_NAME}, unless {@code logging.routes}
109 * names several) via {@link LogRouter.Router.Builder}'s own (package-private)
110 * {@code build()}:
111 * <ol>
112 * <li>Resolve route flags ({@code logging.route.<name>.flags}).</li>
113 * <li>Build a route-scoped level resolver: anything configured directly on the
114 * route builder, layered over {@code logging.route.<name>.level.*}, falling back
115 * to the global level resolver from step 1 (skipped entirely if the route flag
116 * {@code IGNORE_GLOBAL_LEVEL_RESOLVER} is set) - and finally to {@code INFO} if
117 * nothing at all resolves a level.</li>
118 * <li>Resolve appenders - only if none were added programmatically on the route
119 * builder (that check is all-or-nothing: adding even one appender in code skips
120 * property-based resolution entirely). See <strong>Appender resolution</strong>
121 * below.</li>
122 * <li>Resolve the publisher - {@code logging.route.<name>.publisher}, falling
123 * back to a synchronous publisher if unset.</li>
124 * <li>Hand the resolved appenders to the publisher and register the publisher in
125 * the {@link ServiceRegistry}.</li>
126 * </ol>
127 * </li>
128 * <li>{@link #start()} starts the root router, which starts each route's
129 * publisher, which starts each of its appenders, which starts its output (e.g.
130 * opening a file).</li>
131 * </ol>
132 * <strong>Appender resolution</strong> - the part most often mistaken for a bug,
133 * since no appenders are ever added programmatically in the common case:
134 * <ol>
135 * <li>{@code logging.route.<name>.appenders} names the route's appenders; for the
136 * {@value LogProperties#DEFAULT_NAME} route only, a missing value falls back to
137 * the unprefixed {@code logging.appenders}.</li>
138 * <li>If that is <em>still</em> missing: for the default route only, the list
139 * defaults to {@code [file, console]} if {@code logging.file.name} (or Spring
140 * Boot's convention) is set, otherwise just {@code [console]}. A non-default
141 * route with no appenders configured anywhere is a startup failure, not a silent
142 * no-op.</li>
143 * <li>Each named appender then resolves independently. {@code file} and
144 * {@code console} are the two built-in special cases, each with its own output
145 * property/fallback ({@code logging.file.name} then
146 * {@code logging.appender.file.output} for {@code file};
147 * {@code logging.appender.console.output} falling back to standard-out for
148 * {@code console}). Any other name is fully generic:
149 * {@code logging.appender.<name>.output}/{@code .encoder}/{@code .flags}/
150 * {@code .type}, with the output's own URI scheme choosing which registered
151 * {@link LogOutput.OutputProvider} builds it.</li>
152 * <li>An output can supply its own encoder by implementing
153 * {@link LogOutput.ProvidesEncoder} (rare, e.g. some structured outputs): with
154 * {@link LogOutput.ProvidesEncoder.Policy#MANDATORY} that encoder is used as-is
155 * and the {@code .encoder} property is never consulted (configuring one anyway
156 * is a startup failure); with {@link LogOutput.ProvidesEncoder.Policy#DEFAULT}
157 * it is only a fallback and the {@code .encoder} property, if set, still wins.
158 * An output that does not implement {@link LogOutput.ProvidesEncoder} at all is
159 * unaffected - the {@code .encoder} property (or the registry's default for the
160 * output's type) always applies.</li>
161 * </ol>
162 */
163//@formatter:on
164@SuppressWarnings("InvalidInlineTag")
165public sealed interface RainbowGum extends AutoCloseable, LogEventLogger {
166
167        /**
168         * Gets the currently statically bound RainbowGum and will try to load and find one if
169         * there is none currently bound. <strong> This is a blocking operation as in locks
170         * are used and will block indefinitely till a gum has loaded. </strong> If that is
171         * not desired see {@link #getOrNull()}.
172         * @return current RainbowGum or new loaded one.
173         */
174        public static RainbowGum of() {
175                return RainbowGumHolder.get();
176        }
177
178        /**
179         * Gets the currently statically bound RainbowGum or <code>null</code> if none are
180         * <strong>finished binding</strong>. Unlike {@link #of()} this will never load or
181         * start an instance but rather just gets the currently bound one. It will also never
182         * block and does not wait if one is currently being loaded.
183         * @return current RainbowGum or <code>null</code>
184         */
185        public static @Nullable RainbowGum getOrNull() {
186                return RainbowGumHolder.current();
187        }
188
189        /**
190         * Provides the service loader default based RainbowGum.
191         * @return RainbowGum.
192         */
193        public static RainbowGum defaults() {
194                return RainbowGumServiceProvider.provide();
195        }
196
197        /**
198         * Creates a RainbowGum that will <strong>ALWAYS</strong> use the global router.
199         * @param config config.
200         * @return rainbow gum that always uses global router.
201         */
202        public static RainbowGum queued(LogConfig config) {
203                return new SimpleRainbowGum(config, LogRouter.global(), UUID.randomUUID());
204        }
205
206        /**
207         * Sets the global default RainbowGum. The supplied {@link RainbowGum} must not
208         * already be started.
209         * @param supplier the supplier will be memoized when {@linkplain Supplier#get()
210         * accessed} and {@link RainbowGum#start()} will be called.
211         */
212        public static void set(Supplier<RainbowGum> supplier) {
213                RainbowGumHolder.set(supplier);
214        }
215
216        /**
217         * Subscribes to notification of a new RainbowGum becoming the globally bound one (see
218         * {@link #set(Supplier)}, {@link #set(RainbowGum)}, {@link Builder#set()}). This is
219         * primarily for components like SLF4J's logger factory that are themselves
220         * bootstrapped once (often before "the real" RainbowGum has loaded, e.g. a
221         * framework's own pre-boot sequence) and otherwise have no way of finding out that a
222         * different RainbowGum has since replaced the one they captured.
223         * <p>
224         * Only a {@linkplain java.lang.ref.WeakReference weak reference} to
225         * <code>consumer</code> is retained, so subscribing does not by itself keep the
226         * consumer (or whatever it is attached to) reachable - the caller is responsible for
227         * keeping a strong reference to <code>consumer</code> for as long as it needs to keep
228         * receiving notifications, otherwise it may silently stop being called once garbage
229         * collected.
230         * @param consumer called with the newly bound global RainbowGum. Never called while
231         * any RainbowGum internal lock is held.
232         */
233        public static void onGlobalChange(Consumer<RainbowGum> consumer) {
234                RainbowGumHolder.globalChangePublisher.add(consumer);
235        }
236
237        /**
238         * Sets a Rainbow Gum and provides a supplier that will start it globally.
239         * @param gum that will be set immediatly.
240         * @return supplier that will set, get and start the supplied gum and if it is not the
241         * same will throw {@link IllegalStateException}.
242         */
243        public static Supplier<? extends RainbowGum> set(RainbowGum gum) {
244                UUID instanceId = gum.instanceId();
245                RainbowGum.set(() -> gum);
246                return () -> {
247                        var of = RainbowGum.of();
248                        /*
249                         * TODO this is a hack. The holder lock should be used to make this not
250                         * happen.
251                         */
252                        if (!instanceId.equals(of.instanceId())) {
253                                throw new IllegalStateException("Another rainbow gum registered itself as the global. "
254                                                + "This is rare reace condition and probably a bug");
255                        }
256                        return of;
257                };
258        }
259
260        /**
261         * The config associated with this instance.
262         * @return config.
263         */
264        public LogConfig config();
265
266        /**
267         * The router that will route log messages to publishers.
268         * @return router
269         */
270        public RootRouter router();
271
272        /**
273         * Starts the rainbow gum and returns it. It is returned for try-with usage
274         * convenience.
275         * @return the started RainbowGum.
276         */
277        default RainbowGum start() {
278                router().start(config());
279                if (config().debugMode() == LogConfig.DebugModeType.ALL) {
280                        var report = LogReporter.builder().build().report(this);
281                        MetaLog.error(LogEventFactory.of(RainbowGum.class.getName())
282                                .eventNoArg(Level.INFO, "Rainbow Gum started:\n" + report, null));
283                }
284                return this;
285        }
286
287        /**
288         * Unique id of rainbow gum instance.
289         * @return random id created on creation.
290         */
291        public UUID instanceId();
292
293        /**
294         * Will close the RainbowGum and all registered components as well as removed from the
295         * shutdown hooks. If the rainbow gum is set as global it will no longer be global and
296         * replaced with the bootstrapping in memory queue. {@inheritDoc}
297         */
298        @Override
299        public void close();
300
301        /**
302         * This append call is mainly for testing as it does not avoid making events that do
303         * not need to be made if no logging needs to be done. {@inheritDoc}
304         */
305        @Override
306        default void log(LogEvent event) {
307                var r = router().route(event.loggerName(), event.level());
308                if (r.isEnabled()) {
309                        r.log(event);
310                }
311        }
312
313        /**
314         * Use to build a custom {@link RainbowGum} which will use the {@link LogConfig}
315         * provided by the service loader.
316         * @return builder.
317         */
318        public static Builder builder() {
319                ServiceLoader<RainbowGumServiceProvider> loader = ServiceLoader.load(RainbowGumServiceProvider.class);
320                var config = RainbowGumServiceProvider.provideConfig(loader);
321                return builder(config);
322        }
323
324        /**
325         * Use to build a custom {@link RainbowGum} with supplied config.
326         * @param config the config
327         * @return builder.
328         * @see #builder()
329         */
330        public static Builder builder(LogConfig config) {
331                return new Builder(config);
332        }
333
334        /**
335         * Use to build a custom {@link RainbowGum} with supplied config.
336         * @param config consumer that has first argument as config builder.
337         * @return builder.
338         * @see #builder()
339         * @apiNote this method is for ergonomic fluent reasons.
340         */
341        public static Builder builder(Consumer<? super LogConfig.Builder> config) {
342                var b = LogConfig.builder();
343                config.accept(b);
344                return builder(b.build());
345        }
346
347        /**
348         * RainbowGum Builder.
349         */
350        public class Builder {
351
352                private final LogConfig config;
353
354                private final List<Router> routes = new ArrayList<>();
355
356                private Builder(LogConfig config) {
357                        this.config = config;
358                }
359
360                /**
361                 * Adds a router.
362                 * @param route a router.
363                 * @return builder.
364                 */
365                public Builder route(Router route) {
366                        bind();
367                        this.routes.add(route);
368                        return this;
369                }
370
371                /*
372                 * Routers provision outputs/appenders into the config as soon as they are built,
373                 * so the config must be claimed before that, not just at build().
374                 */
375                private void bind() {
376                        ((DefaultLogConfig) config).bind(this);
377                }
378
379                /**
380                 * Adds a route by using a consumer of the route builder.
381                 * @param name name of router.
382                 * @param consumer consumer is passed router builder. The consumer does not need
383                 * to call {@link Router#builder(String,LogConfig)}
384                 * @return builder.
385                 * @see io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogRouter.Router.Builder
386                 */
387                public Builder route(String name, Consumer<Router.Builder> consumer) {
388                        bind();
389                        var builder = Router.builder(name, config);
390                        consumer.accept(builder);
391                        return route(builder.build());
392                }
393
394                /**
395                 * Adds a route by using a consumer of the route builder.
396                 * @param consumer consumer is passed router builder. The consumer does not need
397                 * to call {@link Router#builder(String,LogConfig)}
398                 * @return builder.
399                 * @see io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogRouter.Router.Builder
400                 */
401                public Builder route(Consumer<Router.Builder> consumer) {
402                        bind();
403                        var builder = Router.builder(Router.DEFAULT_ROUTER_NAME, config);
404                        consumer.accept(builder);
405                        return route(builder.build());
406                }
407
408                /**
409                 * Builds an un-started {@link RainbowGum}.
410                 * @return an un-started {@link RainbowGum}.
411                 */
412                public RainbowGum build() {
413                        return build(UUID.randomUUID());
414                }
415
416                /**
417                 * Builds an un-started {@link RainbowGum}.
418                 * @param instanceId unique id for rainbow gum instance.
419                 * @return an un-started {@link RainbowGum}.
420                 */
421                private RainbowGum build(UUID instanceId) {
422                        ((DefaultLogConfig) config).markBuilt(this);
423                        var routes = this.routes;
424                        var config = this.config;
425                        if (routes.isEmpty()) {
426                                var routeNamesResult = config.properties() //
427                                        .forKey(LogProperties.ROUTES_PROPERTY)
428                                        .ofList()
429                                        .or(List.of());
430                                List<String> routeNames = routeNamesResult.validateNow(Builder.class);
431                                /*
432                                 * Validated as a plain list of names, before any of them is used to build
433                                 * a Router, so a bad name is reported against this list property itself,
434                                 * not deferred until some unrelated {name}-keyed property (e.g. this
435                                 * route's own level) happens to interpolate it first.
436                                 */
437                                LogProperty.Validator.validateNames(LogRouter.class, "route", routeNamesResult, routeNames);
438                                if (routeNames.isEmpty()) {
439                                        routes = List.of(Router.builder(Router.DEFAULT_ROUTER_NAME, config).build());
440                                }
441                                else {
442                                        routes = routeNames.stream().map(n -> Router.builder(n, config).build()).toList();
443                                }
444                        }
445                        var root = InternalRootRouter.of(routes, config);
446                        config.changePublisher().subscribe(c -> {
447                                root.changePublisher().publish(root);
448                        });
449                        return new SimpleRainbowGum(config, root, instanceId);
450                }
451
452                /**
453                 * Builds, starts and sets the RainbowGum as the global one picked up by logging
454                 * facades.
455                 * @return started and set rainbow that can be used in a try-close.
456                 */
457                public RainbowGum set() {
458                        UUID instanceId = UUID.randomUUID();
459                        RainbowGum.set(() -> build(instanceId));
460                        var gum = RainbowGum.of();
461                        /*
462                         * TODO this is a hack. The holder lock should be used to make this not
463                         * happen.
464                         */
465                        if (!instanceId.equals(gum.instanceId())) {
466                                throw new IllegalStateException("Another rainbow gum registered itself as the global. "
467                                                + "This is rare reace condition and probably a bug");
468                        }
469                        return gum;
470                }
471
472                /**
473                 * Removes the currently set Rainbow Gum which will close it if one exists and
474                 * will be replaced by the default provision process if {@link RainbowGum#of()} is
475                 * called before {@link #set()}.
476                 * @apiNote This is largely an internal detail for unit testing the provision
477                 * process.
478                 */
479                public void unset() {
480                        RainbowGumHolder.remove(null);
481                }
482
483                /**
484                 * For returning an optional for the LogProvider contract.
485                 * @return optional that always has a rainbow gum.
486                 * @apiNote this method is for ergonomics.
487                 */
488                public Optional<RainbowGum> optional() {
489                        return Optional.of(this.build());
490                }
491
492                /**
493                 * For returning an optional for the LogProvider contract.
494                 * @param condition condition to check if this rainbow gum should be used.
495                 * @return optional rainbow gum.
496                 * @apiNote this method is for ergonomics.
497                 */
498                public Optional<RainbowGum> optional(Function<? super LogConfig, Boolean> condition) {
499                        var cond = condition.apply(config);
500                        if (cond) {
501                                return Optional.of(this.build());
502                        }
503                        return Optional.empty();
504                }
505
506        }
507
508}
509
510final class RainbowGumHolder {
511
512        /*
513         * TODO perhaps a StampedLock would be better performance wise.
514         */
515        private static final ReentrantReadWriteLock lock = new ReentrantReadWriteLock();
516
517        private static Supplier<RainbowGum> supplier = RainbowGumServiceProvider::provide;
518
519        private static volatile @Nullable RainbowGum rainbowGum = null;
520
521        static final GlobalChangePublisher globalChangePublisher = new GlobalChangePublisher();
522
523        /*
524         * Lock free read for per event hot paths (see KeyValuesContributor.global()) where
525         * possibly seeing the previous gum while another one binds is harmless.
526         */
527        static @Nullable RainbowGum peek() {
528                return rainbowGum;
529        }
530
531        static @Nullable RainbowGum current() {
532                if (lock.readLock().tryLock()) {
533                        try {
534                                return rainbowGum;
535                        }
536                        finally {
537                                lock.readLock().unlock();
538                        }
539                }
540                return null;
541        }
542
543        static RainbowGum get() {
544                lock.readLock().lock();
545                try {
546                        var r = rainbowGum;
547                        if (r != null) {
548                                return r;
549                        }
550                }
551                finally {
552                        lock.readLock().unlock();
553                }
554                if (lock.writeLock().isHeldByCurrentThread()) {
555                        throw new IllegalStateException("RainbowGum component tried to log too early. "
556                                        + "This is usually caused by dependencies calling logging.");
557                }
558                RainbowGum newlyStarted = null;
559                lock.writeLock().lock();
560                try {
561                        var r = rainbowGum;
562                        if (r != null) {
563                                return r;
564                        }
565                        r = supplier.get();
566                        start(r);
567                        rainbowGum = r;
568                        newlyStarted = r;
569                        return r;
570
571                }
572                finally {
573                        lock.writeLock().unlock();
574                        /*
575                         * Published outside of the write lock so a subscriber can never deadlock or
576                         * trip the "tried to log too early" reentrancy guard above by, say, trying to
577                         * read a volatile field it owns - it is not calling back into this class.
578                         */
579                        if (newlyStarted != null) {
580                                globalChangePublisher.publish(newlyStarted);
581                        }
582                }
583
584        }
585
586        static boolean remove(@Nullable RainbowGum gum) {
587                lock.writeLock().lock();
588                try {
589                        var original = rainbowGum;
590                        if (gum != null) {
591                                if (original != gum) {
592                                        return false;
593                                }
594                        }
595                        /*
596                         * Reset the global router
597                         */
598                        if (original != null) {
599                                LogRouter.global().close();
600                        }
601                        rainbowGum = null;
602                        supplier = RainbowGumServiceProvider::provide;
603                        return true;
604                }
605                finally {
606                        lock.writeLock().unlock();
607                }
608        }
609
610        static void set(Supplier<RainbowGum> rainbowGumSupplier) {
611                Objects.requireNonNull(rainbowGumSupplier);
612                if (lock.writeLock().isHeldByCurrentThread()) {
613                        throw new IllegalStateException("RainbowGum component tried to log too early. "
614                                        + "This is usually caused by dependencies calling logging.");
615                }
616                lock.writeLock().lock();
617                try {
618                        rainbowGum = null;
619                        supplier = rainbowGumSupplier;
620                }
621                finally {
622                        lock.writeLock().unlock();
623                }
624        }
625
626        private static void start(RainbowGum gum) {
627                Objects.requireNonNull(gum);
628                ShutdownManager.addShutdownHook(gum);
629                gum.start();
630                InternalRootRouter.setRouter(gum.router());
631        }
632
633}
634
635/*
636 * Unlike LogConfig.ChangePublisher/LogRouter.RouteChangePublisher (both scoped to a
637 * single RainbowGum/router instance and torn down with it) this is a JVM-lifetime static
638 * registry, so consumers are held only weakly - otherwise every SLF4J logger factory (or
639 * any other subscriber) ever created over the life of the JVM, e.g. across many
640 * short-lived RainbowGums in tests, would be pinned forever.
641 */
642final class GlobalChangePublisher {
643
644        private final Queue<WeakReference<Consumer<RainbowGum>>> consumers = new ConcurrentLinkedQueue<>();
645
646        void add(Consumer<RainbowGum> consumer) {
647                consumers.add(new WeakReference<>(consumer));
648        }
649
650        void publish(RainbowGum gum) {
651                for (var it = consumers.iterator(); it.hasNext();) {
652                        var consumer = it.next().get();
653                        if (consumer == null) {
654                                it.remove();
655                        }
656                        else {
657                                consumer.accept(gum);
658                        }
659                }
660        }
661
662}
663
664final class SimpleRainbowGum implements RainbowGum, Shutdownable {
665
666        private final LogConfig config;
667
668        private final RootRouter router;
669
670        private final AtomicInteger state = new AtomicInteger(0);
671
672        private final UUID instanceId;
673
674        private static final int INIT = 0;
675
676        private static final int STARTED = 1;
677
678        private static final int CLOSED = 2;
679
680        public SimpleRainbowGum(LogConfig config, RootRouter router, UUID instanceId) {
681                super();
682                this.config = config;
683                this.router = router;
684                this.instanceId = instanceId;
685        }
686
687        @Override
688        public LogConfig config() {
689                return this.config;
690        }
691
692        @Override
693        public RootRouter router() {
694                return this.router;
695        }
696
697        @Override
698        public RainbowGum start() {
699                int current;
700                if ((current = state.compareAndExchange(INIT, STARTED)) == INIT) {
701                        return RainbowGum.super.start();
702                }
703                throw new IllegalStateException("Cannot start. This rainbowgum is " + stateLabel(current));
704        }
705
706        @Override
707        public UUID instanceId() {
708                return this.instanceId;
709        }
710
711        @Override
712        public void close() {
713                if (state.compareAndSet(STARTED, CLOSED)) {
714                        RainbowGumHolder.remove(this);
715                        try {
716                                shutdown();
717                        }
718                        finally {
719                                ShutdownManager.removeShutdownHook(this);
720                        }
721                        return;
722                }
723        }
724
725        @Override
726        public void shutdown() {
727                router().close();
728                config().alerts().close();
729                config().serviceRegistry().close();
730        }
731
732        @Override
733        public String toString() {
734                return "SimpleRainbowGum [instanceId=" + instanceId + ", config=" + config + ", router=" + router + ", state="
735                                + stateLabel(state.get()) + "]";
736        }
737
738        private static String stateLabel(int state) {
739                return switch (state) {
740                        case INIT -> "created";
741                        case STARTED -> "started";
742                        case CLOSED -> "closed";
743                        default -> {
744                                throw new IllegalArgumentException("" + state);
745                        }
746                };
747        }
748
749}
